5152b8af14:
Soon the last door will open! I will open it!
And then this world will end. No one can stop it now.
The whirlpool of hatred that covers this universe!
2c84b0707f:
That's reckless!
Surely even you understand how much damage
our forces have taken, Director Azrael!
27097c8264:
You're the one who doesn't understand the situation!
Over there!
We can't leave a thing like that standing!
082e1a1a98:
Once it fires, it'll be too late!
Reckless or not, you will destroy it!
It and the PLANTs, before Earth gets shot!
ec64161e69:
Will they fire it?
At Earth...
52cf6cc85a:
The true purpose of a powerful long-range weapon of
mass destruction is deterrence. But it has been fired now.
The nukes, and that... Neither side will hesitate anymore.
660c559ae7: So the button for that and the button for the nukes are the same...
182eb18572:
We can't let either the nukes or that light fire on
the other! Once that happens, it'll all be too late.
1ac4d3b358:
Heh, I'll show you I can use it.
If that man could, there's no reason I can't.
fb89227aa3:
Rau Le Creuset was born a clone of Mu La Flaga's
father. But flaws in the cloning technology got him
judged a failure, and he was cast aside.
35d75ef1a6:
Hating the world that made him so, Le Creuset
schemed to destroy mankind. For him, the war between
ZAFT and the Alliance was the perfect stage for revenge.
5890267359:
Le Creuset leaked the Neutron Jammer Canceller data
to the Alliance, setting off the nuclear attack
on ZAFT's space fortress.
4bed4f17a8:
Burning for revenge, ZAFT half-destroyed the Alliance
fleet with the giant laser GENESIS and aimed the next
shot at Earth. If it fired, Earth would become a dead world.
09da4f8b8a:
As the Archangel and the Alliance closed in to stop
GENESIS, Le Creuset smiled to himself before his
new machine, the Providence Gundam.
0cc09ca288:
I have won!
GENESIS will fire any moment now!
0b7d039d89:
There is no way to stop it now! The earth will burn, and
the tears and screams will be the signal fire of new strife!
c3d1b681c2:
Le Creuset laughs at Kira, who can only watch
helplessly as GENESIS reaches critical.
3821ee6752:
The flash GENESIS unleashed pierced the Earth, and
a giant fireball covered its surface...
That day, Le Creuset's revenge was complete.
